White Mage: A healer and protector who restores HP, cures ailments and revives allies.
Black Mage: An offensive caster focused on elemental damage, destructive magic and powerful spells.
Red Mage: A versatile caster combining healing, elemental spells and status magic.
Blue Mage: Uses Enemy Skill to learn monster techniques, including unusual attacks, healing and utility.
Time Mage: Controls battle tempo and gravity, with space-themed magic and travel utility.
Summoner: Calls creatures for damage, support and revival. Specializes in Summon Materia and W-Summon.
Mystic Knight: Combines magic with physical combat. Links elemental and status effects to weapon or armor slots.
Monk: A martial fighter combining powerful strikes, counterattacks and endurance with healing and ailment recovery.
Gambler: A luck-and-rewards specialist using risky critical strikes, Throw and Coin, with extra gil and experience rewards.
Ranger: A ranged scout using distance, awareness and pre-emptive attacks.
Gunner: A ranged attacker using reach, sweeping and rapid-fire attacks, enemy analysis and experience rewards.
Beastmaster: Studies and controls enemies, influences encounters with lure Materia, and calls Choco/Mog as a creature companion.
Scholar: A tactical mage who studies enemies, exploits elemental weaknesses, and supports allies with healing and protective magic.
Mime: Repeats allies' actions, uses Sense and Deathblow before Master Command is available, and improves survival with HP Plus.
Chemist / Alchemist: An item and recovery specialist using W-Item, Morph, healing, revival and poison for battlefield support.
Mystic / Oracle: A curse and drain specialist who disables enemies, removes protections, and sustains battle through HP and MP absorption.
Sage: A master caster with the full Magic Materia catalogue and advanced casting support.
Knight: A physical protector who covers allies, retaliates with Counter Attack, and combines Deathblow with Added Cut.
Paladin: A protective fighter blending Cover and endurance with healing and defensive magic.
Warrior: A physical attacker using strong strikes, multi-hit attacks and extra HP.
Samurai: A precise fighter focused on Deathblow, Double Cut and Slash-All.
Thief: Steals items, strikes opportunistically and improves speed, luck and gil rewards.
Ninja: A fast attacker using Throw, Double Cut, Poison and surprise-oriented support.
Dragoon: A durable long-reach fighter whose Deathblow can be paired with HP Absorb or MP Absorb for draining strikes.
Dark Knight: A dark fighter using Deathblow, Poison and Destruct, supported by HP and MP absorption and extra HP.
